description: Local config of is-this-backtest-lambo-or-lada. Copy this file to the default location ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME or ~/.config, then tradeblocks-skills/is-this-backtest-lambo-or-lada/local-config.json; TRIAGE_CONFIG overrides it), keep it outside the skill and fill it in; scripts/triage-config.mjs names what is still missing. No value here ships with the skill.

costs.file: <path to your cost file in the format of templates/costs.json (Option Omega units)>

notes: Relative paths resolve against this file's folder (after following a symlink); commands run in that folder. costs: give either file or command (argv array that prints the same JSON, e.g. a converter from your own cost file); base: the scenario the checks run at. costs.example: only after you confirmed the shipped example: {"confirmedAt": <ISO time>} with base "example" and file and command null.
